snippet.title: Odd's Job Demo Out Now on Steam | A Wholesome Indie Platformer
snippet.description:
Jump, bounce, and roll through jobs to unite Odd’s family in their new home. Unlock quirky relatives, grab collectibles, and explore differently themed worlds in this wholesome platforming adventure.

Demo out now on Steam!
Wishlist to stay updated :)
